summary: Procure & onboard VextorDB enterprise seats for embeddings store pilot (research + infra)
description:
Issue summary: Procurement request to purchase VextorDB enterprise subscriptions to support a cross-team embeddings store pilot.

Business impact: Research and Platform teams require a managed vector database for low-latency retrieval experiments tied to Redwood’s Optimize and Dedicated feature pilots. Delaying procurement will push the pilot by 3–4 sprints and block benchmark comparisons.

Scope: Purchase 40 enterprise seats with SCIM/Okta provisioning, EU data residency option for eu-west workloads, audit logs retention 12 months, and SLA (99.9% uptime) included. Contract to include DPA and standard security questionnaire responses (SOC2/ISO27001 evidence).

Requirements checklist:
- SCIM provisioning via Okta (group -> role mapping)
- SSO (SAML/Okta) configured for automatic provisioning and deprovisioning
- Billing to ENG-PLAT-23 with tagging for research:team=rl-research and platform:cost-center mapping
- EU data residency for eu-west workloads and ability to pin datasets to region
- Admin roles for 5 infra engineers, 10 dev leads, and 25 dev/research seats
- Logging export to our SIEM (SPLUNK) and 12-month audit log retention

Constraints & compliance: Legal review required for contract terms, DPA, and subprocessors. Security requires a vendor security questionnaire and access to SOC2 report before signing. Procurement prefers a month-to-month pilot but vendor prefers annual; negotiate 6-month trial transitioning to annual.

investigation_notes: Confirmed vendor offers a 60-day trial for enterprise features; trial includes SCIM and EU tenancy but not the full audit-log export (requires add-on).
Benchmarked VextorDB performance on sample embeddings — p95 query latency within acceptable range for pilot (~30ms on eu-west region).
Finance requested an estimate with 3 options: 6-month pilot (discounted), 12-month standard, 12-month committed with volume discount.
blockers: Awaiting SOC2 report and encryption key management documentation from vendor (Security).
Legal redline outstanding for limitation of liability and data processing clauses.
Finance needs PO/chargeback code before procurement completes.
